structure_assets.description: Figure 1: study-level pre-reduction CQD TEM/HRTEM, size, EDS and SAED; upstream CQD recipe is external. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 2: post-reduction Ag/CQD TEM/HRTEM, size, SAED, EDS/maps; visible d/e panel labels conflict with caption. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 3: XRD compares CQDs and Ag/CQDs; ~32.57° plane-label conflict (112 body versus 122 plot/caption). Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 3 CQD trace is an input comparator, not the Ag/CQD product trace. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 4 XPS supports Ag/carbon surface chemistry, not an atomic-coordinate model. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 5 FTIR input/product comparison supports surface-group interpretation only. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 6a baseline Ag/CQD SPR; other panels represent controls/series and are not its size/phase outcome. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 6b with-NH4OH spectrum lacks SPR; no corresponding branch TEM/XRD is supplied. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 6c has four volume labels without a reagent name; body/caption conflict, no structure series. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 7 input CQD zeta potential −4.91 mV; source figure comparison, not particle coordinates. Publisher permission unverified.
Figure 7 Ag/CQD product zeta potential −9.91 mV; source figure comparison, not particle coordinates. Publisher permission unverified.
SI Figure S1 is the authors' process schematic; heating/filter details conflict with main p.3. It is not measured structure. Publisher permission unverified.
Existing independent bulk fcc Ag reference; does not encode this Ag/CQD particle's coordinates, carbon support, surface or size.
Original symbolic CQD-stock identity card for the previously synthesized input; no atomistic model or measured particle geometry.
Original symbolic aqueous Ag/CQD route illustration; disputed main/SI heating stages are shown as unresolved, not selected conditions.

quality.review_scope: Independent scoped quick audit accepted main PDF pp.1–10 for the packaged Ag/CQD route, named optical comparison branches, Figures 1–7 and main-referred SI p.1 Figure S1. Main pp.11–13, the antibacterial assay/mechanism, SI pp.2–5 and upstream coal-to-CQD methods remain outside this synthesis–structure scope; this is not a complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: Coal-to-CQD precursor preparation is delegated to references 37–39; this source supplies only the CQD stock concentration and 200 µL aliquot.
NH4OH branch lacks base volume/concentration linkage, addition order, stage temperatures/times and any measured size or phase.
Figure 6c four volume labels cannot be assigned to CQD or AgNO3 feed because body, caption and plot disagree/omit identity.
No sample-level batch/replicate map connects Figure 1 input CQDs or Figures 2–7 measurements to a unique physical aliquot.
Product ultrafiltration duration, wash volumes and retained fraction are not independently reported; main does not name a product-filter cutoff, while SI S1 labels 0.22 µm.
conflicts: Main PDF p.3 explicitly says 15-min mixing at room temperature and p.7 says 45-min reduction at room temperature; main-referred SI PDF p.1 Figure S1 marks heating (Δ) during both steps. Both reports are retained without selecting a reactor setpoint.

Figure 2 has three incompatible panel attributions: visible labels show (d) size and (e) SAED; p.4 body and caption call the size histogram (e), with caption assigning SAED to (d); p.5 body calls SAED (e). The visible panels support d=size/e=SAED, without treating the body as uniform.
Main PDF p.5 body assigns the ~32.57° XRD peak to (112), while Figure 3 plot/caption labels (122).

Main PDF p.7 body attributes Figure 6c to changing CQD concentration and a steady intensity decrease; Figure 6 caption calls it varying AgNO3 amount, the legend has only 50/100/200/400 µL, and plotted intensity is nonmonotonic. No dose–response or reagent assignment is inferred.
